observations: Photo 0: used automotive alternator, dusty casing, cooling vents visible, watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'U-ZION LINKS AUTO'S'
Photo 1: rear/pulley-side view of same alternator, showing mounting ears and a black pulley cover, no brand or part number visible
Photo 2: side view showing serrated multi-rib pulley and electrical connector housing, surface dirt and corrosion present, no legible markings
No manufacturer logo, part number, or voltage/amperage rating readable in any photo
No multimeter, bench test rig, or video evidence of the unit running
Seller's follow-up message is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo, video, or document was provided

identity.kind: car alternator (used, generic automotive spare part)

claims.evidence: No shipping label, customs tag, or import document visible in any photo
Seller repeats the claim verbally but still no bench test, multimeter reading, or running clip shown
No audio/video of unit running to confirm absence of bearing noise
Alternators carry no odometer or mileage marker; no supporting document shown
Casing seams and screws not shown close-up; cannot confirm absence of prior disassembly

claims.claim: 'I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true'
claims.evidence: Verbal assurance with no accompanying photo or video; treated as seller's word only, not proof

risks.risk: Internal bearing wear or brush wear causing noise/failure under load
risks.proof: Video clip of alternator spinning freely by hand or running on a bench test rig with charging light/voltage shown

risks.risk: Electrical output below spec (weak charging voltage)
risks.proof: Photo or video of multimeter showing output voltage at idle and at higher RPM

risks.risk: Incompatibility with buyer's vehicle (wrong pulley size, connector type, or mounting bracket)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of part number/casting number on housing, and confirmation of the car make/model/year it was pulled from
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified fitment, buyer assumes compatibility risk

risks.risk: Corrosion on terminals or internal rust affecting longevity
risks.proof: Close-up photo of electrical terminal block and internal rotor/stator contacts
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/functional unknown, treated conservatively

risks.risk: Seller's generic claims ('Tokunbo from Belgium', 'low mileage') used as unverifiable boilerplate across multiple listings
risks.proof: Any Belgium-origin paperwork, import invoice, or part-specific documentation
risks.if_unproven: ignored for pricing purposes, treated as standard used part

proof_requests: Video of the alternator spinning on a bench test rig with a voltmeter attached, showing charging voltage
Close-up photo of any part/casting number stamped on the housing
Confirmation of the exact vehicle make, model, and year this was removed from
Close-up of the electrical connector and terminal area for corrosion check
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not raise the verdict above unverified; the item remains priced at worst case as an untested used alternator until bench-test proof or part-number identification is supplied.
